title: Travel Agents: Taiwan — Player Aid
subtitle: On your turn: do ONE action · then trim your Larder to 7

sections.heading: Do ONE action
lines: VISIT (here): flip 3 from this region's market — the event fires by scope, keep 2 ingredients (Big Eater 大胃王 keeps 3).
CONVENIENCE STORE (anywhere): flip 1 from any region's market — take the ingredient, or the event fires.

TRAVEL: move 1 region (HSR = 北↔南); flip 1 on arrival (event whiffs). Then GROW: 1 follower, supply → your board. (Homebody 媽寶 draws 2 from the region she LEFT; Globetrotter 阿嬤 reaches ANY region, tiring 1 follower to supply.)
PROMOTE (here): place up to 2 followers FROM YOUR BOARD onto face-up stall(s) here — stacked or spread, in full view.

BRIBE A STALL (here): win it if you hold STRICTLY MORE followers on it than every rival AND meet its crowd floor (Big Brother 大哥 wins ties) + pay its ingredients − your region discounts (no follower cost). It joins your tour + may complete a Booking. Your followers come HOME to your board; each loser's scatter to their OWN supply. Leave the slot empty.
LINE UP A BOOKING: take 1 from the face-up row, then refill. Your Bookings are your whole score (成團 completed / 取消 cancelled).

sections.heading: Followers · piles · market
lines: FOLLOWERS (your colour meeples): a TRAVEL grows 1 (your supply → your board); a PROMOTE places up to 2 (your board → onto a stall). Win the stall → they come HOME to your board; lose → back to your OWN supply.
Your board's three card slots: your FOLLOWERS slot, plus the two Booking piles — 成團 COMPLETE (ran → full value) and 取消 CANCELLED (didn't run → half value). The piles are your whole score.

Every market card shows its region (colour + emblem) and ☀ day / ☾ night — that pair IS its discard pile. Spent / fired / passed-over cards go to that region+phase discard; when a deck runs out, shuffle its discard back in. SINK = to the BOTTOM of the live deck (stays in play). At DUSK / LAST TRAIN the ending phase's decks AND discards go to the BOX.
